questions.question: What does chapter 14 review?
options: The yearly feasts and sacred days
Clean and unclean foods, and tithing
The rules for going out to war
The choosing and duties of a king
questions.answer: Clean and unclean foods, and tithing

questions.question: What were the Israelites to set apart each year?
options: A portion of their silver and gold
The firstborn of all their flocks
The best part of their vineyards

questions.question: Israel was called a holy people to the LORD.
